notes.title: Update Notes: August 2025
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all so much for your patience.[/b]

Seriously. I know it has been a long time since the last update, and I acknowledge that the delay in releasing Book Three has been far, far longer than I ever intended.

There have been so many unexpected personal circumstances over the last year that have really impacted my ability to just sit down and write. While I can't go into much detail here, please know that Heart Fragment still means the world to me and I am committed to seeing it through to completion. Things are still in motion, just... small, little bits of manageable motion at a time.

As a reminder of some of the good news:
[list]
[*] Jasper's route is fully written and programmed. We just need to do the beta testing before release.
[*] Natalia's act 1 & act 2 are complete. Only act 3 and her endings are left to write, and progress has been made into act 3.
[*] All of Natalia's CGs are done in both art styles. Jasper's CGs are finished in Style B. The StarxSocial style CGs are also complete, both Jasper and Natalia.
[/list]
That is to say, things are far closer to finished than not finished. So just hang in there a bit more! 

Also... What's new in this update? The big one: Dexter finally has a sprite. Woohoo! Most other things are small fixes or file prep for the future, but I hope you all enjoy finally getting to see Dexter in all his glory.

I know the wait has been long and I appreciate everyone who has stuck around. Those who have believed in me all this time are like a pillar that keeps me going. 

Thank you. Seriously.

notes.title: May Update - Art Updates, New Scenes, Male MC Variation
notes.content:
[h1]The long-awaited update to Book One is finally here![/h1]

A ton of new & high requested features are now available, including:
[list]
[*] Art style selection between "style a" and "style b" for more consistency than the previous version
[*] A male MC variation
[*] Option voice acting for Xani / the MC provided by Jessica Spencer (feminine voice) and Jerron Bacat (masculine voice)
[*] Extra scenes & options to build romance prior to the endings
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36878729/78227fcaf8ee442a58412a1b346a08bf5701e420.jpg[/img]
[h2]Art Updates:[/h2]
The number one requested feature / update was more art style consistency. A lot of people found it off-putting that the style of the CGs was so different from the sprites. While Momoriin, the original sprite artist, was unavailable to work on CGs, the help of amazing artists Drulle and Saigogogo has allowed for a new version of CGs that match more seamlessly with the original sprites.

For those who already love the CG artstyle, you can select "style b" to see sprites & CGs both by the lovely artist who did the original scenes, Mintstea! You can also switch between the two styles at any time during gameplay, and both styles of any unlocked CG can be viewed from the gallery menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36878729/5cf4cb74ea0042894f9ff2c993ed2f7391c5383b.jpg[/img]
[h2]Main Character Variation:[/h2]
As unlocked by our amazing Kickstarter backers, you can now play as a male/masculine version of the protagonist! It was highly requested that pronouns be interchangeable, and indeed they are. You can switch the protagonist's appearance, voice, etc at any time while you play the game.

This difference is not just cosmetic. A lot of scenes (especially in Clive's route and the upcoming Book Two release which includes Shannon's route) have dialogue and choice variations depending on which version of the protagonist you play as. And if you want to take it a step further, you can also turn on option MC voicing as well!

[h2]Book Two Progress Report:[/h2]
First off, I want to offer a huge apology for the release delay. A lot has been happening, both in my personal life, general health, and my work life. As the sole writer of Heart Fragment aside from a few additional scenes provided by Nico H (developer of Entropic Float), any issues that I face directly impact the speed I can work at.

Book Two: Belief Fragments will still be available this summer (2022). Lana's route is finished aside from end programming + beta testing, and Shannon's is nearly finished being written and will then be moved into the programming stage as well. I really appreciate your patience with me!

Lastly, if anyone runs into any issues with the new update, please feel free to contact me any time, whether it is by email (heartfragmentvn@hotmail.com), the Steam community page, or even commenting right here on this update.

Have a lovely day, everyone!

notes.title: 3 Days Left on Kickstarter | Stretch Goals for epilogues & MC customization
notes.content:
[h2]The [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/heartfragmentvn/heart-fragment-otome-visual-novel-complete-edition]Heart Fragment: Complete Edition Kickstarter[/url][/b] ends in just 3 days! We're 100% funded but working towards some amazing stretch goals. [/h2]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/673/541/e0582c35bc597fd9fdaf2960e0656433_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=680&fit=max&v=1637707786&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=3a4a9287986342d332784442180dc529[/img]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/646/435/28908b3f767555067251d408d13991e2_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=680&fit=max&v=1637467080&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=e97a49b9f9a33748bb9858f7b0b0d988[/img]

Here's a recap of the how, the why, and everything else you might be asking:

[b]Q: I already own the game. Will I still be able to play all the future content?[/b]
A: Yes, absolutely! Book Two, Book Three, and the Finale will still be available to all who own Book One as free DLC. The bonus of backing this Kickstarter is that you get the future group ending DLCs for free, early access to future releases if you back a tier that includes it, get some bonus merch, and a chance to help Heart Fragment be released as quickly as possible + reach some stretch goals. 

[b]Q: What will the Kickstarter funds be used for?[/b]
A: Right now, I'm paying for most assets out of my own pocket. This will let me get the remaining assets for Book Two, Book Three, and the Finale. In other words, I'll no longer be at a net loss with the creation of Heart Fragment. It'll also allow me to release the future parts much quicker than I could otherwise. +

[b]Q: What is the group ending DLC?[/b]
A: These optional DLCs will be included free to anyone who backs Heart Fragment on Kickstarter, and will cost approximately $2 to $5 each after that. They will be released after Book Three. The full list of group DLCs is:

- Clive & Shannon (branches off of Shannon's route, adds 4 new endings)
- Kay & Clive (branches off of Kay's route, adds 3 new endings)
- Clive & Jasper (branches off of Clive's route, adds 4 new endings)
- Jasper & Shannon (branches off of Jasper's route, adds 2 new endings)
- Natalia & Jasper (branches off of Natalia's route, adds 3 new endings)

[b]Q: The campaign talks about an option to switch art styles, but I own Book One and haven't been able to find it.[/b]
A: This option will be added along with the release of Book Two in March. 

[b]Q: What merch is available?[/b]
A: There's digital merch, including the OST, artbook, wallpapers, and full HD copies of all CGs and physical merch in the form of double-sided acrylic chibi charms.
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/426/522/37f25ffcd486537d50b9907e9c3a9419_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=680&fit=max&v=1635734412&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=02cf0649ff2cc8464788e2befaed6189[/img]

[b]Q: I only want merch, not another copy of the game. Can I do that?[/b]
A: Yep, just choose the add-on tier and you can customize what you get with your order!

[b]Q: Why two art styles?[/b]
A: The number one thing that people were displeased with during the release of Heart Fragment is the inconsistency between the sprite art & the CG art. Many people said this ruined the experience by breaking immersion. That's why CGs are being made to match the sprite artwork, and the CG artist is doing a version of the sprites in their artstyle. It would be unfair to both artists who put so much hard work into their art to have them removed entirely, which is why the option to choose between them is being added instead.
You can switch between "Style A" and "Style B" at any time during your gameplay, as demonstrated below:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/LdhM228/ezgif-3-6da9a6cb95ac.gif[/img]

Thank you all for your support! Much love!

notes.title: Update Notes (September 15, 2021)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Back with a few more updated custom backgrounds, some minor bug fixes, and a few notes for Book Two and beyond!

[list]
[*] Custom backgrounds added for: cafe (outside), flowerfield, school, Shannon's bedroom, MC's bedroom at Lana's house, the store.
[*] Small update made to Gray's living room background to add a photo of the MC's mother to the wall.
[*] Fixed an error with the glossary/notes to self section that displayed an entry too soon.
[*] Minor typo fixes and narrative fixes.
[/list]

Now, a few notes for future developments... 

As you likely know, Heart Fragment was Kickstarted in 2020. Since then, the game has grown significantly and along with that growth have been a lot more expenses than originally planned for - and the cost of the creation makes Book Two, Book Three, and the Finale harder to finish within a reasonable time. I've also done the best as I can to be upfront about how the exchange rate from my country's CAD to the usually used USD and rising PayPal fees made for unplanned expenses. Since [b]all future additions to the game will be FREE,[/b] I've needed to consider a few other options.

I have made the decision to start a Kickstarter that will fund the remainder of costs for creating everything from Book Two to the Finale. This will help me make things as quickly as possible AND allow me to offer some wonderful stretch goals. The Kickstarter will also include... *drumroll* physical merchandise in the form of chibi charms / keychains! 

Stretch goals will be added to include more full voice acting in major scenes, a Nintendo Switch port in the future, and a physical copy of the artbook. There will also be additional tier rewards for custom characters that can be added starting in Book Two.

To clarify, anyone who backed the previous Kickstarter will receive any newly added digital rewards at the tiers they backed! Additionally, an 'add-on' tier would be added for people who want physical merchandise only.

More updates will be posted on this soon. Please know that while your help is appreciated, you're of course not required to back the upcoming books. You will still receive your copy of Book Two and beyond that are promised along with your purchase of Book One. 

Thank you so much for supporting Heart Fragment. I hope you are all enjoying the game so far and that I can continue to provide you with an enjoyable experience!

notes.title: Update Notes (August 25, 2021)
notes.content:
I hope August has been wonderful for everyone! Here's a summary on the update that just went live:
[list]
[*] Updated notes to self system - there is now a huge expansion to the 'notes to self' including category navigation, more notes added, character specific notes with details about each character as you learn about them, and a full timeline that will arrange all the information you learn in the order of events.
[*] New contacts menu in the phone
[*] Contact screens are updated to look more like actual social media profiles; they also link directly to the character's gallery page and their notes to self section
[*] Due to a lot of confusion about how the hearts or stars next to names work in regards to affection level, this has been revamped. Character contact pages now have separate bars for level of platonic bond & level of romantic bond that fill up as your bond does. This makes it easier to picture where exactly you are on the scale instead of guesswork based on colors alone. 
[*] To make accessing the new affection system easier, once you are on a character's route you will find a "quick access contact" on the phone's home screen which will take you quickly to their profile
[*] Texting system now shows the entire chat log for that scene instead of one message at a time
[*] New custom background for Gray's living room & new custom hospital background
[*] Bug fix with one of Clive's bad endings that made sprites appear larger than intended + fixed a variable that could lead to an exception error occurring
[/list]
Additionally, I updated from Ren'py 7.4.4 to Ren'py 7.4.8 for this build (aka the latest version). Based on initial testing it doesn't seem like this update should interfere with anything, but if anyone runs into bugs/errors do not hesitate to report them to me. 

Thank you and have a nice day!

notes.title: TWO DAYS until launch!
notes.content:
I am extremely excited to announce that the release of [i][b]Heart Fragment: Book One[/b][/i] is officially coming in (a bit less than) 2 days! 

To say I'm eager to show you all what we have accomplished in Heart Fragment so far is an understatement. I truly hope that the game not only lives up to but exceeds your expectations thus far.

[previewyoutube=XR_SBfI3Q2g;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A few notes for the release:[/b]
[list]
[*] The July 30 release is "Book One: Fantasy Fragments" and contains the full routes for Kay and Clive. All future books will be made available as [b]free DLC[/b]!
[*] According to beta tester reports, linear playthroughs took an average of 7 hours per route and going back to get all endings and achievements took a reported average of 15 hours.
[*] Achievements earned in the demo should automatically be added when you open the full game. In Book One, there are a total of 42 achievements to earn!
[*] Future books will be "Book Two: Belief Fragments" (Lana and Shannon), "Book Three: Despair Fragments" (Jasper and Natalia), and "Book 2XXX: Finale". Approximate dates for those releases will be announced soon.
[/list]

Additionally, a known bug may occur when reloading demo save files. This is due to adjustments to the inner psyche system and quality-of-life changes that were made for the full release. To fix & bypass the error, simply press the "rollback" button that appears in the bottom left corner of the screen (some players may need to press it twice). After that, your file will load properly and any future saves within that file will not encounter the issue. This problem only occurs in old save files - new ones are not affected.

Wishing you all well!

tags.bug: Additionally, a known bug may occur when reloading demo save files.

notes.title: December Update: New Trailer, New Content⭐
notes.content:
A huge demo update just went live. This is the the last planned change before the full release aside from any potential typo & bug fixes until the full game is released on JULY 31, 2021.

What's new:
[list]
[*]The majority of the characters now have sprites
[*]A preview into some of the routes
[*]A new feature that allows you to use a certain power the protagonist possesses
[*]Small 'side stories' that give context to things happening outside of the main game events
[*]More animations in nightmare sequences
[*]More story content & CGs
[*]Steam achievement flags added - when the full game is released, all of your unlocked achievements from your demo data will be awarded automatically!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=KahfBJEwRRE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b]

This update contains significant alterations to some areas of the script due to new features & side character sprites. Unfortunately, this may lead to issues loading old save files if you saved during a highly altered scene. In addition, text that you have read may be marked as unread. The fix: start a new game & turn on the "skip all" option. You will skip past any text (whether it is marked as read or unread) allowing you to quickly get back to where you were.

I recommend doing this regardless of if you have save file issues or not though if you are playing on Steam, because Steam achievement data has been newly added to the script. In other words, the achievement flag will not be triggered if you completed an older version.

notes.title: New Update LIVE: updated sprites are finally available!
notes.content:
It has finally been posted: Heart Fragment's final big demo release! 
[previewyoutube=zeSlScnexyk;full][/previewyoutube]
What's new:
[list]
[*]All main character sprites have been updated
[*]A huge expansion to the soundtrack
[*]More CGs and voice acting
[*]Story revamp, new features, tons of new dialogue and scenes throughout
[*]Difficulty settings
[/list]

Still to be added:
[list]
[*]An option to switch between sprite styles
[*]Phone menu updates, including a chat history log and photo gallery of social media CGs that you've collected
[*]A bit more partial voice acting
[/list]

Important note: Because the game's code and structure has changed significantly while I learn how to code and optimize things, there is a chance that if you ran a previous version of the game you may run into errors while loading a save file. I recommend starting a new game, since a huge amount of the prologue is updated, and using the skip feature to bypass anything you've seen before.

The demo is a little over 60,000 words. I am very much looking for feedback on this length because I worry it might be too long. The routes make up for it by being far more than double that length each, but I have created a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeyfAW24tEZBvbu2o20iCfsU2NNssqT2R1MOqQnhwgAp6OhDQ/viewform][b]feedback form[/b][/url] for anyone that would like to offer input on that, or to report bugs/typos and give other feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36878729/e57a6a7216b544bb902e24268cc006516a52d59a.png[/img]

See you all next time!
-Casper Swann

notes.title: HUGE Demo revamp now live
notes.content:
[h2]IT IS FINALLY LIVE: a huge revamp to the demo!
[/h2]
What's new? Well... a lot.
[olist]
[*] A ton of the prologue has been[b] rewritten in places that weren't fully satisfying[/b], including [b]many new choices to make[/b].
[*] A ton of [b]new scenes[/b] in the prologue.
[*] [b]Revamped GUI [/b]- the only thing that isn't updated yet is the main menu screen because the art is not finished. This update will come very soon!
[*] [b]New art & new CGs![/b]
[*] [b]New voice acting![/b] A few things to note on this: an audio engineer (Tristan Stone) is now working on Heart Fragment to level out all of the voice acting and enhance the quality so that it doesn't get drowned out by music. These updates still need to be made for most of the main cast, and the updated voice acting for Shannon will not be included until the next version with the new main menu, due to Samantha Chan working full time in the medical field at the moment.
[*] [b]An intro into the social media feature[/b], which will be expanded further in the full game.
[*] A few [b]updated sprites [/b]have been included in the new version of the demo. The updated sprites will continue to be added as they are finished (Shannon, Kay, Natalia, Lana, and Inigo are being worked on right now). 
[*] A few[b] new songs[/b] on the soundtrack.
[/olist]
[i]So, hooray for progress![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gqRJvDl.png[/img]

As for an update on what's going on with development right now, I have plenty of updates there as well!
[list]
[*] All of the main CGs for Kay's route are finished now!
[*] Act One of Kay's route is fully written and polished and Act Two is coming along very well.
[*] An option to switch between sprite styles is functional now for the sprites that are completed.
[*] Lavendel's sprite styles (to be seen in the next demo update!) are now animated with blinks and lip flaps.
[*] More to come soon! Thanks for keeping up to date on Heart Fragment!
[/list]
If you are able to, [b]please consider helping us out by buying us a [url=https://ko-fi.com/heartfragment]Ko-fi over here[/url][/b]. I'm struggling a bit with keeping up on the finances involved with developing a game. While the Kickstarter was fully funded, I did not fully account for the impact the exchange rate from CAD to USD would have on things. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qolc82a.png[/img]

Have a nice day everyone!

- Casper Swann

notes.title: Issue with Steam release of the demo + Kickstarter update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4TXQuRk.png[/img]
[h1]Heart Fragment's demo is now available to download on Steam![/h1]
... But only the demo. Some people got emails that made it sound like the full game was released. This is not the case - the release date is still set for late 2020/early 2021. What was intended to be posted was the demo, but I'm still new to using Steam as a developer and seem to have made a mistake somewhere along the way. 

I'm very sorry for any confusion that this might have caused, and I hope you'll all continue to bear with me despite this! Steam support has been contacted and I'll hopefully be able to get this sorted out ASAP. 

[b]Now... on to some good news!
[/b]
[h1]We are officially fully funded on Kickstarter![/h1]
With a little under 3 days left we managed to reach our goal! 🎉🎉🥂 This is incredible. I’m so proud of how much has been accomplished and I can’t even describe how exciting this is. Its been a long, anxiety-inducing journey but in the end, it paid off and I’m so glad for how well we’ve done.

Three days may not sound like much time but let’s keep pushing on towards our stretch goals! To recap:
[list]
[*] $100 CAD over our goal ($3300 total funding) will get each route extended, including the prologue. The extension of the prologue will include more choices to impact the personality options available to the player, and moments that were going to be told in flashbacks during Kay’s route will be told in real-time with dialogue options to impact Kay’s route before it even begins!
[*] $600 over our goal ($3800 total funding) will add in an extra route with 3 endings! Backers will get to vote on her design out of a few possible options. 
[*] $1000 over our goal ($4200 total funding) will get extra CGs in each route, which also means extra fully voiced scenes too! Each route will get at least 2 extra CGs.
[*] $2300 over our goal ($5500 total funding) will get all background artwork uniquely commissioned! This means all scenes will be shown exactly as they should be, down to the smallest detail.
[/list]
I've also got some other wonderful news! In April, Heart Fragment will be getting a full GUI revamp. The new GUI will include character bios where you can select & view sprites, a music box with the soundtrack, a text log for missed dialogue, and a social media feature that check throughout the game and see bonus text from the characters!

For anyone who has yet to see, the game also now has unlockable personality traits for the main character based on your choices that will unlock extra scenes and dialogue options. These include confident, honest, creative, paranoid, bored, and gullible.

Additionally, because of the complex way that the endings in Heart Fragment will be set up in the final route, I wrote this up to explain it more clearly! The game has over 20 endings, with a mix of romantic, platonic, and family based endings available. Someone asked recently if you're supposed to end up with one character; if someone is the "true" romance. So, to explain that:

[b]In the final route, who your “endgame” partner is will be up to you!
[/b]
Each character will be featured in a section of the final route. At the end of each of their sections, you will be given a choice: KISS THEM or HUG THEM

If you KISS THEM: You can select them as your endgame partner! You can kiss multiple characters and choose between them, but you’ll get bonus text for only kissing one!

If you HUG THEM: You can select them as your endgame BFF! You can hug multiple characters and choose between them with no “penalty” for hugging them all.

You can have an endgame partner & endgame BFF, just an endgame partner, or just an endgame BFF. If you don’t choose to kiss or hug any of them, the ending will be more focused on the full group.

Whether or not you can choose a character as a romantic or platonic partner at the end will depend on what endings you get in their route. While the final route will be unlocked by completing at least one romantic or platonic ending for every character, you can only select a romantic partner who you have completed a romantic ending with. Doing both their romantic and platonic endings will make them an option for both!

That's all for now folks! Let's keep pushing on until the very end!

- Casper Swann
